Maya (docs): Heads-up 1: I'm preparing a model card update for Aurora-XL about variant routing (auto-routing between "fast" and "accurate" variants). Need a tiny migration example and a short bench line.

Ethan (eng-runtime): TL;DR: routing policy defaults to latency-first. You can pin `variant=accurate` or set `routing=cost` in the request. If you relied on implicit fallback order before, call out new field `routing_policy`.

Priya (eng-ml): Bench note: under default routing median latency ~95ms (fast), accurate variant p50 ~220ms, p95 ~480ms. Accuracy delta ~3.2% on our eval set. Include that sentence.

Max (sdk): Draft JS snippet for explicit routing: 
```js
const client = new RedwoodClient({apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY});
await client.generate({model:'aurora-xl', routing_policy:'accuracy', variant:'accurate', prompt:'...'});
```

Max (sdk): Curl example: `curl -X POST /v1/generate -d '{"model":"aurora-xl","routing_policy":"latency","prompt":"..."}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_API_KEY"`

Maya (docs): Nice. Add a one-line migration note: "If you previously depended on implicit fallback ordering, explicitly set `routing_policy` to preserve behavior." Also add reviewers @Ethan and @Max.

ci-bot: docs-ci: lint check started for PR #4222.

Ethan (eng-runtime): Also include compatibility note: SDKs <2.3.0 won't accept routing_policy; advise HTTP or upgrade.
